meta: Part 3 of "Your own AI assistant". Once you're used to asking AI for help, your chat list quickly gets messy: housework, office work and homework all mixed together. Projects fix that.
prompt: Family of 4, our child is in 3rd grade, food budget is $300 a month

muc.title: A messy chat list
muc.text: Last time, we built a prompt library. But the chat list is still a mess: housework, office work, your kid's homework, all mixed together.

muc.title: One room per task
muc.text: Many chat apps have a feature called projects. Each project is like a private room for one task.

muc.title: What's in the room?
muc.text: Each room has three things: instructions just for that task, the documents you need, and every chat about it.

muc.title: No more pasting
muc.text: Open a new chat in a room, and AI has already read that room's instructions and documents. You never have to paste them again.

muc.title: Nothing gets mixed up
muc.text: Each room has its own tone and its own set of documents, and nothing spills over.

muc.title: Create your first project
muc.text: Create a project for a task you do often, like "Family". Write a few lines of instructions and upload two related documents.

muc.title: Part 4: a research helper
muc.text: Your room has documents now. Part four turns them into a helper that looks things up for you.
